title: Nvidia shares fall about 8% after hours on Wed 11 Nov 2026 (US time; CBS: more than 8%, to $159.51; TechCrunch: about 8%) after The Wall Street Journal reports the board is preparing to oust co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang and could meet as soon as Wednesday to decide; Reuters (source) says the board is meeting on his future; the board's independent investigation, announced 8 Nov, concerns reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort (board: no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised); no successor named, analysts see no obvious successor (CBS, TechCrunch); no board decision announced as of ~08:00 IST 12 Nov; Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and has led it 33 years; Q3 FY27 results 17 Nov, call 2 pm PT (03:30 IST 18 Nov). Follows @idlynews' 10 Nov post on the probe.
